fixes.explanation: Double would be a nice surprise, like finding a second tray of dough you forgot you made. But the verse goes the other direction. The LORD began to reduce the size of Israel (2 Kings 10:32). Hazael, king of Aram (2 Kings 8:13), defeated the Israelites throughout their territory, so the land was shrinking.

Measure sounds so official, like I'd grab a ruler and put on a very serious face. But the verse says the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel (2 Kings 10:32). That's land shrinking, not land being checked. Hazael, king of Aram (2 Kings 8:13), defeated the Israelites throughout their territory.

Forty! You rounded up like me when I'm counting cookies and trying to sneak a few extra. But the text says Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-eight years (2 Kings 10:36). That's twelve fewer than you picked. Twenty-eight is still almost three decades, long enough to wear a groove in any throne.
